notes: Adapted from the April 2020 MEPS Workshop's first exercise, which teaches the same estimate (proportion of persons with a health care expense) three independent ways: numeric CLASS variable, character variable, and PROC SURVEYFREQ -- plus a DOMAIN breakdown by age group. Substituted a mock cdata.h216 (20 rows, 5 strata) for the author's restricted-access 2019 MEPS Full-Year Consolidated File. Two mechanical edits for Jenner parser gaps found while building this bundle (both filed as regression tests): PROC SURVEYFREQ's STRATUM statement changed to STRATA (Jenner accepts the STRATUM alias only in PROC SURVEYMEANS; both are valid SAS since real SAS 9.4 supports STRATUM as an alias in every survey procedure); and the DOMAIN block's FORMAT statement replaced with a pre-computed character age-group column, since Jenner's PROC SURVEYMEANS does not yet accept a FORMAT statement inside the PROC step. All three survey-procedure methods converge on the same ~58% estimate in the captured run, same as the exercise is designed to demonstrate.
